items.title: Add allow-list fields to Home pill storage and shared types
items.description: Add optional allowedUserIds and allowedGroupIds fields to the shared skill-pill and MCP-pill types, and extend the admin project-settings read and write path so the full pill list — including these new fields — is returned and persisted exactly as every other pill attribute is today. No new tables or columns: both fields live inside the existing JSON-backed pill arrays on the project's skill settings row.
definitionOfDone: Skill-pill and MCP-pill shared types carry optional allowedUserIds and allowedGroupIds fields
Admin project-settings GET returns the full pill list including allow-list fields
Admin project-settings PUT persists allow-list fields on both skill and MCP pills without a database migration
Existing pills with no allow-list fields continue to round-trip unchanged
technicalDependencies: Existing project skill settings persistence for quick skill and MCP pills
nonFunctionalRequirements: Admin read/write path continues to return the full pill list unfiltered for authorized editors

items.title: Extend Admin Project Settings pill editor with allow-list controls
items.description: Add a user/group selection control to each pill row (skill and MCP) in the Admin Project Settings pill editor, following the existing project user/group picker pattern used for reviewer and approver pools, so a Project Admin can set or clear an allow-list without leaving the editor.
definitionOfDone: Each skill pill row exposes a user/group selection control bound to its allow-list fields
Each MCP pill row exposes the same user/group selection control bound to its allow-list fields
Saving the pill editor persists allow-list changes alongside existing pill attributes
Clearing a pill's allow-list back to empty restores the everyone-with-Home-access default
technicalDependencies: TBI-001 allow-list fields on skill and MCP pill types
nonFunctionalRequirements: Selection control is keyboard-navigable and screen-reader labeled
Editing one pill's allow-list does not require reloading the full pill list

features.title: Configure Home Pill Allow-Lists
outOfScope: Restricting Interview, ADR, or any other non-Home skill selector
Validating that an allow-listed user or group belongs to the project being configured
features.description: Project Admins configure per-pill allow-lists — specific users or groups — on Home skill and MCP pills for any Apex project, so only intended people see and can start those shortcuts.

personaBehaviors.behavior: Configure per-pill allow-lists for Home skill and MCP pills, specifying which users or groups can see and start each pill

items.title: Build a pill access resolver for live allow-list evaluation
items.description: Build a resolver that, given a project's configured Home pills (skill and MCP) and a caller's identity, returns the subset of pills that caller may use and whether that caller may start a Home thread at all under the project's current pill configuration. The resolver applies the empty-allow-list-means-everyone default, evaluates group membership live against current project group data, and exempts the Platform Admin (Super Admin) identity from every check. It is the single source of truth consumed by both the skill-config read path and Home thread creation.
definitionOfDone: Resolver returns the allowed subset of skill and MCP pills for a given caller and pill configuration
Resolver returns whether a caller may start a pill-less Home thread given the project's pill configuration
Resolver treats a Platform Admin (Super Admin) identity as allowed on every pill
Resolver treats a missing or deleted group reference in an allow-list as granting no access
Unit tests cover the empty-allow-list default, non-empty allow-list matching by user and by group, and the Platform Admin bypass
technicalDependencies: TBI-001 allow-list fields on skill and MCP pill types
nonFunctionalRequirements: Resolver evaluation is a pure function of its inputs (pills, caller identity, membership) with no direct HTTP or database coupling of its own

items.title: Filter and strip Home pills on the public skill-config read path
items.description: Extend the public skill-config read path to run its Home skill and MCP pill arrays through the pill access resolver for the requesting caller, returning only the pills that caller may use with allowedUserIds and allowedGroupIds omitted from each. Every other field on that response is left exactly as it is today, so Interview, ADR, and other consumers of the same read path see no change in behavior.
definitionOfDone: Public skill-config response includes only pills the caller may use
allowedUserIds and allowedGroupIds never appear in the public response
Platform Admin callers receive every configured pill on the public response
Interview, ADR, and other skill-config fields unrelated to Home pills are unchanged in the response
nonFunctionalRequirements: No new fields are added to the public response beyond the existing pill shape minus the two allow-list fields
Non-Home-pill fields on the response are unaffected

items.title: Enforce pill access on Home thread creation
items.description: Extend Home thread creation to call the pill access resolver before persisting a new thread: accept the kickoff only when it names an allowed configured pill (skill or MCP) or carries no pill and the caller is allowed to start Home chat at all under the project's pill configuration, otherwise deny with an explicit error. Platform Admin (Super Admin) is exempt. This check runs only on thread creation — reopening a thread the caller owns and sending further messages on it are untouched.
definitionOfDone: Thread creation denies a kickoff naming a pill the caller is not allowed on
Thread creation denies a pill-less kickoff when the project has pills and the caller is allowed on none
Thread creation allows a pill-less kickoff when the project has no configured pills
Thread creation allows any kickoff from a Platform Admin (Super Admin) caller
Sending a message on an existing thread the caller owns is unaffected by this check
nonFunctionalRequirements: The check runs before a new thread row is persisted, so a denied kickoff creates no thread
The check does not run on existing-thread read or message-send paths

items.title: Update Home composer for filtered pills and blocked-start state
items.description: Update the Home composer to render only the pill arrays already filtered by the skill-config read path, and to disable sending a pill-less message when the project has pills configured and the caller's filtered arrays are both empty, with an explanatory message. This mirrors the server-side rule client-side for a clear experience; the server-side check remains the actual enforcement boundary.
definitionOfDone: Composer renders only the filtered pill arrays from skill-config
Composer disables pill-less send when the project has pills and the caller's filtered arrays are both empty
Composer allows pill-less send unchanged when the project has no configured pills
Existing pill selection and send flow for allowed pills is unaffected
nonFunctionalRequirements: Composer disabled-state message is screen-reader accessible
Composer behavior degrades safely if the skill-config response is slow or errors, defaulting to disabled rather than allowing an unchecked send

features.title: Enforce Home Pill Access
outOfScope: Re-checking pill access on every follow-up message of an existing thread
Hiding a user's own thread history when their pill access is later removed
features.description: Authenticated Users see and can start only the Home skill and MCP pills their allow-list permits, Platform Admin sees and can start every configured pill to verify configuration, and Project Admin follows the same allow-lists as any other user on Home — closing every path (visible pills, thread creation, and pill-less chat) a restricted user could otherwise use to reach a skill they aren't allowed on.
dependencies: Requires the allow-list fields and admin editor from Configure Home Pill Allow-Lists

personaBehaviors.behavior: See only Home skill and MCP pills in their allow-list; blocked from creating threads with unauthorized pills or when no pills are allowed; can continue existing threads even after losing pill access
See and can start every configured Home pill regardless of allow-lists to verify configuration
Follow the same allow-lists as any other user; subject to pill visibility and thread creation restrictions

outOfScope: Applying allow-lists to Interview, ADR, or any other skill/model selector outside Home pills
A separate project-level restricted-Home-users list independent of any specific pill
assumptions: "Super Admin" in the originating conversation maps to the Platform Admin persona; the bypass behavior is scoped to Apex's existing super-admin bypass and does not extend to every Project Admin
Group allow-list membership reuses the existing project groups membership model; no new group type or membership table is introduced
No database migration is required — allow-list fields are added inside the existing JSON-backed pill arrays already stored on the project's skill settings row
epics.description: Project Admins currently cannot limit which users see or start a given Home skill or MCP pill — every pill is visible to everyone with Home access. This blocks projects that want to hand a narrow group of users a single-purpose entry point (for example, a Knowledge-only shortcut for BI & Analytics) without exposing every other shortcut on the project. This epic adds per-pill user/group allow-lists, configurable for any project, and enforces them everywhere a Home thread can start.
successMetrics: A Project Admin can restrict at least one Home skill or MCP pill to a defined set of users or groups without engineering involvement
Zero reported incidents of a user starting a Home skill outside their configured pill allow-list within 30 days of rollout

personas.name: Authenticated User
personas.description: Any logged-in Apex user with Home access who sees and starts Home skill/MCP pill conversations

personas.name: Project Admin
personas.description: Per-project admin who configures Home pill allow-lists in Project Settings and, on Home itself, follows the same allow-lists as any other user

personas.name: Platform Admin
personas.description: Platform-level administrator (Super Admin) who bypasses Home pill allow-lists to see and start every configured pill

businessRules.rule: An empty or omitted allowedUserIds and allowedGroupIds on a Home pill (skill or MCP) means every user with Home access may see and start that pill.
Group allow-list membership is evaluated against live project group membership at the moment of the request; no membership snapshot is stored on the pill.
Platform Admin (Super Admin) sees and may start every configured Home pill regardless of allow-lists.
businessRules.appliesTo: See every Home pill as Platform Admin

businessRules.rule: Project Admin's own Home pill visibility and thread-start eligibility follow the same allow-lists as any other user; the unrestricted view of all pills is limited to the Project Settings pill editor, not Home itself.
businessRules.appliesTo: See only the Home pills I'm allowed to use

businessRules.rule: When a project has one or more configured Home pills and the current caller is allowed on zero of them, Home thread creation is denied, including a pill-less kickoff.
businessRules.appliesTo: Blocked from starting a Home thread with no allowed pills

businessRules.rule: When a project has no configured Home pills at all, pill-less Home thread creation remains allowed, unchanged from today.
businessRules.appliesTo: Blocked from starting a Home thread with no allowed pills

businessRules.rule: Home thread creation must reference an allowed configured pill (skill or MCP) or be pill-less when the caller is allowed to start Home chat at all; access is enforced only at thread creation, so the owner of an existing thread may keep messaging even after later losing access to that thread's pill.
businessRules.appliesTo: Continue using a Home thread after losing pill access

businessRules.rule: Home pill allow-list enforcement applies only to Home skill and MCP pills; Interview, ADR, and other consumers of the shared skill-config read path are unaffected.

assumptionsMade: "Super Admin" in the originating conversation maps to the Platform Admin persona for backlog and persona classification; the bypass behavior described (seeing and starting every Home pill) is scoped to Apex's existing super-admin bypass, and does not extend to every user holding the Project Admin role — Project Admin follows the same allow-lists as any other user on Home.
Group allow-list membership reuses the existing project groups membership model; no new group type or membership table is introduced.

A configured Home pill "match" for enforcement purposes is a skillPath equal to a configured skill pill's skillPath, or an MCP kickoff whose server identity equals a configured MCP pill's mcpServerName; any other kickoff is treated as pill-less for enforcement purposes.

Admin-side allow-list entries are validated only for being well-formed identifiers; validating that a referenced user or group actually belongs to the project being configured is not required by this PRD and should be confirmed with the admin experience owner.
No database migration is required — the allow-list fields are added inside the existing JSON-backed pill arrays already stored on the project's skill settings row.

implementationPhases.rationale: The PRD scopes exactly one epic. Within it, Feature-level dependsOn (Enforce Home Pill Access depends on Configure Home Pill Allow-Lists) sequences building the allow-list data and admin editor before the read-path filtering and thread-creation enforcement that consume them.
